StableCodec: Taming One-Step Diffusion for Extreme Image Compression

StableCodec：面向极低码率图像压缩的单步扩散适配

11 页原论文 · SD-Turbo / 双分支编解码 / 隐式码率剪枝 · 离线阅读

作为高效扩散压缩的结构基线来读：辅助编码补充保真信息，辅助解码分担结构，单步扩散生成细节。

学习导读 · 以下为阅读辅助分析，与论文译文分开

先建立理解框架

核心问题

多步扩散解码慢，且细节可能偏离原图。StableCodec 利用 SD-Turbo 单步生成，结合深度潜变量压缩与双分支结构，兼顾码率、真实性和保真度。

编码端补充信息

SD 的 VAE 主要面向感知重建，其浮点潜变量未必适合超低码率熵编码。因此引入冻结的高码率 ELIC 分析变换作为辅助编码器，把两路特征对齐到16倍空间降采样后沿通道拼接，再深层压缩。这里的熵感知主要来自辅助特征的训练背景，并非新增标签概率校准。

解码端结构分担

主分支从 ŷ 生成 l_T，经单步 U-Net 得到 l₀；D_Aux 直接从 ŷ 恢复结构，绕过 U-Net。两路在 VAE 解码前结合，使 g_s 更集中提供细节生成引导。图5展示能量与重建变化，但不意味着严格的频率分离。

码率与训练

主潜变量在64倍空间压缩处编码，超先验在256倍处编码，再恢复到8倍潜空间。四步自回归熵模型是四叉树上下文轮次，去噪仍单步。IBP 第一阶段用较小 λ 在宽松码率约束下适配；第二阶段提高乘在 R 前的 λ 降码率，并加入 GAN。λ 的意义须看其乘在哪一项。

评测注意

原始分辨率评测包含 CLIC 428张、DIV2K 100张和 Kodak 24张。LPIPS 训练用 VGG，评测默认 AlexNet。重点指标为 FID、KID、DISTS；Kodak 样本少，不报告 FID/KID。速度在 RTX 3090 上测试，显存还依赖分块策略，不能直接拼接其他设备结果。

与你的研究对照

本篇主要创新是辅助编解码结构与单步适配；TagEntropy 和 GDFA 则强调语义先验对熵建模和优化的作用。其 CLIP 距离是图像语义嵌入监督，不等于 GDFA 的冻结扩散特征对齐。借鉴训练方案时须控制码率，避免将工作点变化当成模块影响。

自检问题

E_Aux 为何冻结，而 SD 编码器加 LoRA？D_Aux 在何处融合？VAE 解码器为何不加 LoRA？λ增大为何码率降低？四步熵模型与单步扩散如何共存？

StableCodec: Taming One-Step Diffusion for Extreme Image Compression

StableCodec：面向极低码率图像压缩的单步扩散适配

Tianyu Zhang Xin Luo Li Li Dong Liu MOE Key Laboratory of Brain-Inspired Intelligent Perception and Cognition, University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei 230093, China

通信作者：刘东。

Abstract

摘要

Diffusion-based image compression has shown remarkable potential for achieving ultra-low bitrate coding (less than 0.05 bits per pixel) with high realism, by leveraging the generative priors of large pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models.

基于扩散的图像压缩借助大规模预训练文生图扩散模型的生成先验，在实现低于0.05比特每像素的超低码率编码并保持高真实性方面展现出显著潜力。

However, current approaches require a large number of denoising steps at the decoder to generate realistic results under extreme bitrate constraints, limiting their application in real-time compression scenarios.

然而，在极端码率约束下，现有方法需要在解码端执行大量去噪步骤才能生成逼真结果，限制了其在实时压缩中的应用。

Additionally, these methods often sacrifice reconstruction fidelity, as diffusion models typically fail to guarantee pixel-level consistency.

此外，由于扩散模型通常无法保证像素级一致性，这些方法往往牺牲重建保真度。

To address these challenges, we introduce StableCodec, which enables one-step diffusion for high-fidelity and high-realism extreme image compression with improved coding efficiency.

为应对这些挑战，我们提出 StableCodec，通过单步扩散实现兼具高保真度、高真实性和更高编码效率的极低码率图像压缩。

To achieve ultra-low bitrates, we first develop an efficient Deep Compression Latent Codec to transmit a noisy latent representation for a single-step denoising process.

为达到超低码率，首先设计高效的深度压缩潜变量编解码器，传输用于单步去噪的带噪潜在表示。

We then propose a Dual-Branch Coding Structure, consisting of a pair of auxiliary encoder and decoder, to enhance reconstruction fidelity.

随后提出由一对辅助编码器和解码器构成的双分支编码结构，以增强重建保真度。

Furthermore, we adopt endto-end optimization with joint bitrate and pixel-level constraints.

此外，采用联合码率与像素级约束的端到端优化。

Extensive experiments on the CLIC 2020, DIV2K, and Kodak datasets demonstrate that StableCodec outperforms existing methods in terms of FID, KID and DISTS by a significant margin, even at bitrates as low as 0.005 bits per pixel, while maintaining strong fidelity.

在 CLIC 2020、DIV2K 和 Kodak 上的大量实验表明，即使码率低至0.005 bpp，StableCodec 在保持较强保真度的同时，FID、KID 和 DISTS 仍显著优于现有方法。

Additionally, StableCodec achieves inference speeds comparable to mainstream transform coding schemes.

此外，其推理速度与主流变换编码方案相当。

Code is available at our project repository.

代码见项目仓库。

1. Introduction

1. 引言

Image compression is a foundational problem in signal processing.

图像压缩是信号处理领域的基础问题。

Driven by advances in digital imaging and the widespread use of social platforms, the volume of image data in modern multimedia has grown exponentially, placing increasing demands on the coding efficiency of image compression techniques.

随着数字成像进步和社交平台普及，现代多媒体图像数据量呈指数增长，对压缩技术的编码效率提出更高要求。

Over the past few decades, traditional codecs such as JPEG [62] and H.266/VVC [10], along with emerging learning-based methods [4, 5, 12, 18, 19, 28, 42, 44, 45], have been widely adopted in real-world image compression applications.

过去数十年，JPEG [62]、H.266/VVC [10] 等传统编解码器，以及新兴学习式方法[4,5,12,18,19,28,42,44,45]，已广泛应用于实际图像压缩。

However, these methods are typically optimized for rate-distortion performance, and often produce unrealistic and blurry reconstructions, particularly under severe bitrate constraints, as shown in Fig. 1.

然而，这些方法通常针对率失真性能优化，往往产生不够真实、较模糊的重建，尤其是在严格码率约束下，如图1所示。

To tackle this issue, generative image compression [2, 43] optimized for human perceptual performance has gained increasing attention.

为解决这一问题，针对人类感知性能优化的生成式图像压缩[2,43]受到越来越多关注。

These methods are evaluated based on the rate-distortion-perception tradeoff [8, 9, 67, 68], and progressively demonstrate their advantages in producing visually appealing reconstructions at lower bitrates compared to traditional codecs or common neural codecs.

这些方法依据率—失真—感知权衡[8,9,67,68]进行评估，并逐渐展示出相对传统或普通神经编解码器，在更低码率下生成视觉效果良好重建的优势。

A prominent research direction [3, 21, 31, 43, 43, 46, 66] involves integrating a discriminator into the transform coding pipeline [5, 20, 44], employing adversarial training to enhance the perceptual quality of reconstructions.

一个主要方向[3,21,31,43,43,46,66]是在变换编码流程[5,20,44]中加入判别器，通过对抗训练增强重建感知质量。

Motivated by the impressive generative capabilities, more researchers [11, 24, 35, 40, 51, 59, 65, 69] have begun exploring the potential of diffusion models, particularly the generative priors in large pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) models, to compensate for severely distorted information at ultra-low bitrates while ensuring perceptually consistent generation.

受扩散模型出色生成能力启发，更多研究[11,24,35,40,51,59,65,69]开始探索扩散模型，尤其是大型预训练文生图模型的生成先验，在超低码率下补偿严重失真信息并保持感知一致性的潜力。

A recent study, PerCo [11], produces realistic results at an extreme bitrate as low as 0.003 bits per pixel (bpp) using a pretrained latent diffusion model (LDM), highlighting the potential of diffusion-based generative codecs on image compression at more severe bitrates.

近期 PerCo [11] 利用预训练潜扩散模型，在低至0.003 bpp的极端码率下获得逼真结果，展示了扩散生成式编解码器在更严格码率约束下的潜力。

Despite these promising advancements, existing methods face two primary limitations inherent to diffusion models.

尽管取得进展，现有方法仍有两项源于扩散模型本身的主要局限。

First, they require dozens of denoising steps at the decoder to produce results with sufficient perceptual quality.

首先，解码端需要数十次去噪才能得到足够好的感知质量。

Second, the reconstructions often deviate from the original images, as diffusion models typically do not guarantee reconstruction consistency.

其次，由于扩散模型通常无法保证重建一致性，结果经常偏离原图。

To address the first challenge, we consider leveraging the generative priors in SD-Turbo [54], a distilled version of Stable Diffusion 2.1 [52] that enables real-time image synthesis in 1 to 4 denoising steps.

针对第一项挑战，我们考虑利用 SD-Turbo [54] 的生成先验。它是 Stable Diffusion 2.1 [52] 的蒸馏版本，可在1至4步去噪内实时生成图像。

Following [73], we demonstrate that SD-Turbo can produce perceptually consistent reconstructions with a single-step denoising process, even for severely corrupted inputs and a general positive prompt, as shown in Fig. 2.

遵循文献[73]，我们表明，即使输入严重损坏且只提供通用正向提示，SD-Turbo 也能通过单步去噪得到感知一致的重建，如图2所示。

We thus pose an intuitive question: Can we compress a noisy latent representation of the original image, which can be effectively denoised in a single-step diffusion process, using an ultra-low bitrate?

因此，我们提出一个直观问题：能否以超低码率压缩原图的带噪潜在表示，使其可由单步扩散有效去噪？

Building on these insights, we present StableCodec for extreme image compression, which integrates SD-Turbo with the proposed Deep Compression Latent Codec to compress noisy latents at ultra-low bitrates for a single-step diffusion process.

基于上述认识，我们提出面向极低码率图像压缩的 StableCodec，将 SD-Turbo 与深度压缩潜变量编解码器结合，以超低码率压缩用于单步扩散的带噪潜变量。

In response to the second challenge, we introduce a Dual-Branch Coding Structure with a pair of auxiliary encoder and decoder to further enhance reconstruction fidelity.

针对第二项挑战，我们引入一对辅助编码器与解码器构成双分支编码结构，进一步提高重建保真度。

Considering the limitations of the pre-trained VAE encoder on practical entropy coding and reconstruction consistency, we employ a rate-distortion-oriented auxiliary encoder to embed more entropy-aware semantic information for coding decisions.

考虑到预训练 VAE 编码器在实际熵编码和重建一致性上的不足，采用面向率失真的辅助编码器，嵌入更多感知熵编码需求的语义信息，以支持编码决策。

In parallel, we add an auxiliary decoder to perform structure apportionment during the decoding process, improving the generation guidance on the one-step denoising process for more consistent details.

同时，加入辅助解码器，在解码过程中分担结构信息，改善单步去噪的生成引导，使细节更一致。

To enable endto-end optimization, we design a two-stage training objective that jointly optimizes bitrate and pixel-level constraints.

为实现端到端优化，我们设计两阶段目标，联合优化码率与像素级约束。

Benefit from these designs, StableCodec produces highfidelity and high-realism reconstructions at ultra-low bitrates as low as 0.005 bpp.

受益于这些设计，StableCodec 在低至0.005 bpp的超低码率下生成高保真、高真实感重建。

Extensive experiments on CLIC 2020 [60], DIV2K [1] and Kodak [16] demonstrate that StableCodec sets up a new state-of-the-art performance in terms of FID [22], KID [6], and DISTS [14], outperforming existing methods by significant margins.

在 CLIC 2020 [60]、DIV2K [1] 和 Kodak [16] 上的大量实验表明，StableCodec 在 FID [22]、KID [6] 和 DISTS [14] 上取得领先性能，显著超过现有方法。

In terms of computational complexity, StableCodec offers much faster decoding speeds compared to other diffusion-based competitors, achieving inference times comparable to those of mainstream transform coding schemes.

计算复杂度方面，StableCodec 的解码明显快于其他扩散方法，推理时间与主流变换编码方案相近。

For practical deployment, StableCodec supports inference at arbitrary resolutions with memory consumption less than 9 GB.

实际部署时，借助不到9 GB的显存支持任意分辨率推理。

We summarize our contributions as follows: We present StableCodec, an extreme image codec integrating one-step diffusion and Deep Compression Latent Codec to achieve ultra-low bitrate compression with high realism, high fidelity and superior coding efficiency.

贡献如下：提出 StableCodec，将单步扩散与深度压缩潜变量编解码器结合，实现高真实性、高保真度和高编码效率的超低码率压缩；

• We develop Dual-Branch Coding Structure to improve reconstruction fidelity. A pair of auxiliary encoder and decoder is introduced for semantic enhancement and structure apportionment.

设计双分支编码结构，通过辅助编码器与解码器实现语义增强和结构分担；

• StableCodec obtains SOTA FID, KID and DISTS performance on CLIC 2020 and DIV2K dataset, significantly outperforms existing methods at bitrates as low as 0.005 bpp with well-preserved fidelity, and achieves comparable inference speeds with mainstream neural codecs.

在 CLIC 2020 和 DIV2K 上获得领先的 FID、KID 和 DISTS，低至0.005 bpp时仍显著优于现有方法并保留良好保真度，推理速度与主流神经编解码器相当。

Figure 2. (Top) Illustration of our motivation.

图2. 上：研究动机。

One-step diffusion can produce perceptually consistent results given severely corrupted images and a general prompt.

给定严重损坏的图像与通用提示，单步扩散仍能生成感知一致的结果。

(Bottom) Challenges in StableCodec: how to compress a noisy latent for one-step diffusion using ultra-low bitrates, and how to improve fidelity.

下：StableCodec 的挑战是，如何以超低码率压缩用于单步扩散的带噪潜变量，以及如何提升保真度。

2. Related Work

2. 相关工作

2.1. Generative Image Compression

2.1. 生成式图像压缩

Learning-based image compression has shown competitive potential compared to traditional methods [10, 37, 39, 58, 62], leveraging non-linear transforms and joint ratedistortion optimization.

学习式图像压缩通过非线性变换和联合率失真优化，相比传统方法[10,37,39,58,62]展现出竞争力。

Ball´e et al. [4] introduced the first end-to-end learned image compression framework, which was subsequently enhanced with the hyperprior [5] and context model [45].

Ballé 等[4]提出首个端到端学习式图像压缩框架，随后通过超先验[5]和上下文模型[45]加以增强。

Building on this foundation, much work [12, 18, 19, 28, 42, 44, 49] has been devoted to improving both rate-distortion performance and model practicality.

在此基础上，大量研究[12,18,19,28,42,44,49]致力于提高率失真性能与模型实用性。

In practical scenarios, a key challenge is achieving extreme image compression at ultra-low bitrates while maintaining both fidelity and realism [2].

实际场景中的关键挑战，是在超低码率极限压缩下同时保持保真度与真实性[2]。

Traditional image codecs optimized for rate-distortion often produce blurry reconstructions and noticeable artifacts.

面向率失真优化的传统编解码器往往产生模糊重建和明显伪影。

To address this, Mentzer et al. [43] introduced HiFiC and the concept of generative image compression, integrating GANs into codec optimization and evaluating performance in terms of the rate-distortion-perception tradeoff [8, 9, 67, 68].

为此，Mentzer 等[43]提出 HiFiC 及生成式图像压缩概念，将 GAN 引入编解码优化，并从率—失真—感知权衡[8,9,67,68]评估性能。

Subsequent research can be broadly categorized into two main approaches.

后续研究大体分为两类。

The first category [3, 21, 31, 43, 46] focuses on enhancing transform coding [5, 20, 44] for human perception by incorporating adversarial losses and optimized discriminator architectures, which typically can be extended to a wide range of bitrate and a flexible decoding control between fidelity and realism [3, 31].

第一类[3,21,31,43,46]通过对抗损失和优化的判别器结构增强变换编码[5,20,44]的人类感知表现，通常能扩展至较宽码率范围，并在解码时灵活控制保真度与真实性[3,31]。

The second category [11, 24, 35, 40, 51, 59, 65, 69] leverages diffusion models for generative image compression.

第二类[11,24,35,40,51,59,65,69]利用扩散模型进行生成式图像压缩。

Although these methods show promise for ultra-low bitrate compression, they are often constrained by reconstruction fidelity and inference efficiency due to the multi-step denoising process.

尽管适合超低码率，其重建保真度和推理效率常受多步去噪限制。

Recently, GLC [26] introduced transform coding in the generative latent space of VQ-VAE [15, 61], achieving more visually appealing results at ultra-low bitrates.

近期 GLC [26] 在 VQ-VAE [15,61] 的生成潜空间中引入变换编码，在超低码率下获得更具视觉吸引力的结果。

2.2. Generative Models and Few-Step Diffusions

2.2. 生成模型与少步扩散

Generative models play a crucial role in image generation.

生成模型在图像生成中发挥关键作用。

While many architectures, such as VAEs [30] and GANs [17], have been explored, diffusion models [55] have emerged as a powerful alternative, achieving state-of-theart synthesis quality.

研究者探索了 VAE [30]、GAN [17] 等多种架构，而扩散模型[55]已成为实现领先合成质量的有力选择。

Inspired by non-equilibrium statistical physics [55], diffusion models learn to reverse a noise perturbation process through a Markovian framework.

受非平衡统计物理[55]启发，扩散模型在马尔可夫框架下学习反转噪声扰动过程。

Recent advancements, such as DDPM [23], DDIM [56], and LDM [52], have significantly reduced computational complexity and improved image synthesis quality, making diffusionbased approaches a dominant force in generative modeling.

DDPM [23]、DDIM [56]、LDM [52] 等进展显著降低计算复杂度并提升合成质量，使扩散方法成为生成建模的重要方向。

To address the inefficiency of iterative denoising, several approaches [53, 54, 57, 70] aim to reduce the number of denoising steps while maintaining generation quality.

为解决迭代去噪效率低的问题，多种方法[53,54,57,70]尝试在保持生成质量的同时减少去噪步数。

These methods train diffusion models to approximate the full denoising trajectory in a single or a few steps, significantly improving inference efficiency.

这些方法训练扩散模型，用单步或少数步骤近似完整去噪轨迹，显著提高推理效率。

Notably, SD/SDXL-Turbo [54] demonstrates image generation in 1 to 4 steps with near-parity quality compared to multi-step models, making real-time diffusion-based applications [48, 63, 73] feasible.

特别是 SD/SDXL-Turbo [54] 能在1至4步内生成接近多步模型质量的图像，使实时扩散应用[48,63,73]成为可能。

3. Method

3. 方法

3.1. Overview

3.1. 概览

In this section, we introduce the overall framework of the proposed StableCodec, built upon SD-Turbo [54] with a VAE encoder ESD, a VAE decoder DSD and a denoising Unet ϵSD. As shown in Fig. 3, we incorporate a Deep Compression Latent Codec to perform extreme transform

本节介绍 StableCodec 的整体框架。它建立在 SD-Turbo [54] 上，包含 VAE 编码器 E_SD、VAE 解码器 D_SD 和去噪 U-Net ε_SD。如图3所示，我们引入深度压缩潜变量编解码器，在 VAE 潜空间中执行极低码率变换编码。

01 码流

Figure 3.

图3. StableCodec 框架。

The framework of StableCodec. We incorporate the proposed Deep Compression Latent Codec to transmit a noisy latent lT for one-step denoising, where 64× denotes a spatial compression ratio of 64.

所提出的深度压缩潜变量编解码器传输用于单步去噪的带噪潜变量 l_T，其中64×表示空间压缩比为64。

To adjust the latent resolution, we deploy DownSample block and Conv3×3 as adapters after the VAE encoder ESD and auxiliary encoder EAux, respectively.

为调整潜变量分辨率，分别在 VAE 编码器 E_SD 和辅助编码器 E_Aux 后加入 DownSample 块和3×3卷积作为适配器。

We use a general prompt in both training and inference.

训练和推理均采用通用提示。

The auxiliary decoder DAux shares a similar structure with gs.

辅助解码器 D_Aux 与 g_s 具有相似结构。

More details on networks are provided in the supplementary.

网络细节见补充材料。

coding in the VAE latent space. To adapt SD-Turbo for image compression, we integrate LoRA [25] into ESD and ϵSD, while keeping DSD unchanged to preserve the generative priors [73].

为将 SD-Turbo 适配到图像压缩，我们在 E_SD 和 ε_SD 中加入 LoRA [25]，同时保持 D_SD 不变以保留生成先验[73]。

Additionally, we introduce a Dual-Branch Coding Structure to enhance reconstruction fidelity, utilizing an auxiliary encoder EAux to embed rich semantic information and an auxiliary decoder DAux to perform structure apportionment.

此外，引入双分支编码结构提高重建保真度，利用辅助编码器 E_Aux 嵌入丰富语义，利用辅助解码器 D_Aux 分担结构信息。

Finally, we optimize StableCodec end-toend with joint bitrate and pixel-level constraints, achieving high-fidelity and high-realism extreme image compression.

最后，采用联合码率与像素级约束进行端到端优化，实现高保真、高真实性的极低码率图像压缩。

3.2. Deep Compression Latent Codec

3.2. 深度压缩潜变量编解码器

We design our latent codec using the extreme analysis transform ga, extreme synthesis transform gs and a 4-step autoregressive entropy model.

潜变量编解码器由极端分析变换 g_a、极端合成变换 g_s 和四步自回归熵模型组成。

To reach ultra-low bitrates, we employ deep compression transform networks for both ga and gs.

为达到超低码率，g_a 与 g_s 均采用深度压缩变换网络。

Specifically, ESD and DSD provide a latent space with a spatial compression ratio of 8 (abbreviated as 8×).

具体而言，E_SD 和 D_SD 提供空间压缩比为8，简称8×的潜空间。

Unlike mainstream schemes [18, 20, 26, 28, 40, 42, 49] that perform entropy coding at 16×, we further downsample and apply entropy coding for ˆy at 64× and the hyperprior [5] at 256×.

主流方案[18,20,26,28,40,42,49]在16×处执行熵编码，而我们进一步降采样，在64×处编码 ŷ，在256×处编码超先验[5]。

Consequently, we use gs to restore the spatial compression ratio to 8× for ϵSD and DSD.

随后使用 g_s 将空间压缩比恢复为8×，供 ε_SD 和 D_SD 使用。

The entire coding process can be formulated as follows:

整个编码过程可表述如下：

In Eq. (1), we first obtain an intermediate latent l from the input image x through ESD and EAux.

式(1)中，首先通过 E_SD 和 E_Aux 从输入 x 获得中间潜变量 l。

Eq. (2) is the latentspace transform coding process to produce a noisy latent lT using ultra-low bitrates.

式(2)为潜空间变换编码，以超低码率产生带噪潜变量 l_T。

Eq. (3) displays the one-step denoising process with the noise schedule {¯αt} [23] in the T-th timestep.

式(3)给出在第 T 个时间步、噪声调度为{ᾱ_t}[23]时的单步去噪过程。

Finally, in Eq. (4), the reconstruction ˆx is obtained from l0 and ˆy using DSD and DAux.

最后，式(4)通过 D_SD 和 D_Aux 从 l₀ 与 ŷ 得到重建 x̂。

To balance performance and coding latency, we construct efficient ga and gs with InceptionNeXt [72] and GatedCNN [71], and build a 4-step antoregressive entropy model with quadtree partition [36] and latent residual prediction [44].

为兼顾性能与编码时延，我们用 InceptionNeXt [72] 和 GatedCNN [71] 构造高效 g_a、g_s，并结合四叉树划分[36]与潜变量残差预测[44]建立四步自回归熵模型。

3.3. Dual-Branch Coding Structure

3.3. 双分支编码结构

While deploying the proposed latent codec with LoRA enables image compression with SD-Turbo at ultra-low bitrates, the reconstruction fidelity is limited.

所提出的潜变量编解码器配合 LoRA，能够让 SD-Turbo 实现超低码率压缩，但重建保真度仍受限。

In this section, we analyze the reasons and introduce Dual-Branch Coding Structure with a pair of auxiliary encoder and decoder, EAux and DAux, to further enhance compression performance.

本节分析原因，并引入由辅助编码器 E_Aux 和辅助解码器 D_Aux 构成的双分支编码结构，进一步提升性能。

3.3.1. Entropy-Aware Semantic Enhancement

3.3.1. 熵感知语义增强

We observed that the VAE in SD-Turbo has several limitations when reconstruction fidelity and practical coding are required.

我们观察到，当要求重建保真度和实际编码能力时，SD-Turbo 的 VAE 存在若干局限。

As noted in [52] and Table 1, this VAE is pretrained for perceptual compression, which does not preserve pixel-level fidelity as well as a rate-distortion-oriented autoencoder from a typical neural codec [20].

如文献[52]及表1所述，该 VAE 为感知压缩预训练，相比典型神经编解码器[20]中面向率失真的自编码器，像素级保真度保留较差。

Additionally, while this VAE provides a compressed representation of the original image, it is still in floating-point format and not optimized for practical entropy coding, making it less suitable for further latent-space ultra-low bitrate compression.

此外，虽然 VAE 提供原图的压缩表示，但仍是浮点格式，未针对实际熵编码优化，因此不利于进一步进行潜空间超低码率压缩。

Building on these insights, we introduce the analysis transform of a pre-trained high-bitrate ELIC model [20] to serve as an auxiliary encoder EAux.

基于这些认识，我们采用预训练高码率 ELIC 模型[20]的分析变换作为辅助编码器 E_Aux。

EAux remains frozen, and provides rich, entropy-aware semantic information of the input images.

E_Aux 保持冻结，为输入图像提供丰富、熵感知的语义信息。

To combine the latents from different encoders, we introduce trainable adapters that align the latent resolutions to a spatial compression ratio of 16, followed by channel-wise concatenation.

为融合不同编码器的潜变量，引入可训练适配器，将分辨率对齐到16倍空间压缩，再沿通道拼接。

During optimization, various pieces of information are learned from different encoders as shown in Fig. 4, where more pixel-level semantic information is embedded into the latent codec through EAux.

优化过程中，从不同编码器学习不同信息，如图4所示，E_Aux 将更多像素级语义嵌入潜变量编解码器。

The pre-trained VAE in SD performs perceptual compression, while the one in ELIC [20] preserves more pixel-level information.

SD 中的预训练 VAE 执行感知压缩，而 ELIC [20] 的自编码器保留更多像素级信息。

3.3.2. Structure Apportionment

3.3.2. 结构分担

The reconstruction quality of StableCodec heavily depends on how the denoising Unet is conditioned.

StableCodec 的重建质量高度依赖去噪 U-Net 的条件方式。

Since a fixed prompt is used for both training and inference, the one-step denoising process is primarily guided by lT , which is produced by gs.

由于训练和推理均使用固定提示，单步去噪主要由 g_s 生成的 l_T 引导。

This places high demands on the capability of gs, resulting in unsatisfactory denoising guidance, as reflected in the reconstructions shown in Fig. 5 (b).

这对 g_s 的能力提出很高要求，导致去噪引导不足，如图5(b)的重建所示。

To alleviate the decoding burden on gs, we introduce an auxiliary decoder DAux to perform an additional decoding branch from ˆy, bypassing the Unet.

为减轻 g_s 的解码负担，我们引入辅助解码器 D_Aux，从 ŷ 构建绕过 U-Net 的额外解码分支。

This design is motivated by the observation that an extremely compressed bitstream contains mainly the basic structure of images.

其动机是，极度压缩的码流主要包含图像基本结构。

We distribute and decode these components directly from the bitstream using the auxiliary branch, allowing gs to focus primarily on producing guidance to generate realistic details.

通过辅助分支直接从码流分配并解码这些成分，使 g_s 主要专注于提供生成逼真细节所需的引导。

Fig. 5 compares StableCodec that is trained with or without DAux.

图5比较有无 D_Aux 的 StableCodec。

When trained without DAux, gs produces all types of information as it is the only decoding branch.

没有 D_Aux 时，g_s 是唯一解码分支，因此必须产生所有类型的信息。

When trained with DAux, structural information is routed (b) Reconstruction comparison, trained w. or w/o 𝒟Aux Figure 5. Impact of DAux on latents and reconstructions.

加入 D_Aux 后，结构信息被分配到辅助分支。图5(b)为有无 D_Aux 训练的重建比较；图5展示 D_Aux 对潜变量与重建的影响。

through DAux, while the energy in gs latents drops significantly.

结构信息经由 D_Aux 传递，而 g_s 潜变量的能量显著降低。

Meanwhile, more semantically aligned details are reconstructed in Fig. 5 (b), suggesting gs now provides better high-frequency guidance for the denoising Unet ϵSD.

同时，图5(b)中重建的细节更符合语义，说明此时 g_s 为去噪 U-Net ε_SD 提供了更好的高频引导。

3.4. End-to-End Training Objective

3.4. 端到端训练目标

We adopt end-to-end optimization with joint bitrate and pixel-level restrictions to train StableCodec.

我们采用联合码率与像素级约束的端到端优化训练 StableCodec。

Given the original image x, the quantized latent ˆy and the reconstructed image ˆx, we construct our training objective based on the standard rate-distortion loss:

给定原图 x、量化潜变量 ŷ 和重建图像 x̂，基于标准率失真损失构造目标：

where the bitrate R and pixel-level distortion D are balanced by the Lagrange multiplier λ.

其中码率 R 和像素级失真 D 由拉格朗日乘子 λ 平衡。

Inspired by [20, 44], we train StableCodec with a 2-stage implicit bitrate pruning (IBP) strategy.

受文献[20,44]启发，采用两阶段隐式码率剪枝（IBP）策略。

We first train a base model using a smaller λbase, adapting the latent codec into SD-Turbo under a relaxed bitrate constraint, and warming up with a more expressive transform.

首先使用较小的 λ_base 训练基础模型，在宽松码率约束下将潜变量编解码器适配到 SD-Turbo，并以表达力更强的变换进行预热。

In the second stage, we finetune the shared base model with larger λtarget to reach ultra-low target bitrates.

第二阶段使用更大的 λ_target 微调共享基础模型，达到超低目标码率。

IBP facilitates efficient and stable training, resulting in improved performance.

IBP 促进高效稳定训练，并改善性能。

The distortion term D includes MSE, LPIPS (using VGG features) [74] and a CLIP [50] distance LCLIP , for which we compute the L2-distance between the CLIP embeddings of x and ˆx.

失真项 D 包含 MSE、使用 VGG 特征的 LPIPS [74]，以及 CLIP [50] 距离 L_CLIP，即 x 与 x̂ 的 CLIP 嵌入之间的 L2距离。

Note that this term is a simplified version from [34], and we find it beneficial for reconstruction at ultralow bitrates.

这是文献[34]的简化版本，我们发现其有利于超低码率重建。

Additionally, we follow [73] and incorporate a GAN loss Ladv to narrow the distribution gap between x and ˆx.

此外，遵循文献[73]加入 GAN 损失 L_adv，缩小 x 与 x̂ 的分布差距。

We use DINOv2 [47] with registers [13] as the discriminator backbone [33].

判别器主干[33]采用带寄存器[13]的 DINOv2 [47]。

To ensure stable training, we incorporate the GAN only in the second training stage.

为稳定训练，仅在第二阶段引入 GAN。

The full objective can be formulated as:

4. Experiments

4. 实验

4.1. Implementation

4.1. 实现

Training Details. We use the training set of DF2K [41] and CLIC 2020 Professional [60] to train StableCodec.

训练细节：使用 DF2K [41] 和 CLIC 2020 Professional [60] 训练集。

During training, we use 512×512 patches with a batch size of 8.

训练图像块大小为512×512，批量为8。

The first training stage takes over 100k iterations with a learning rate of 1e−4 and a λbase of 0.5 (about 0.05bpp).

第一阶段训练超过10万次迭代，学习率为1e−4，λ_base=0.5，对应约0.05 bpp。

In the second stage, we finetune the base model for another 20k iterations with GAN incorporated and λtarget ∈ {2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32}, while the learning rate undergoes 5e−5, 2e−5, 1e−5 and 1e−6 for 5k iterations each.

第二阶段引入 GAN，并令 λ_target∈{2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24,32}，继续微调2万次迭代；学习率依次为5e−5、2e−5、1e−5、1e−6，各持续5000次迭代。

We set d1, d2, d3 and β to 2, 1, 0.1 and 0.1, repectively.

d₁、d₂、d₃、β 分别设为2、1、0.1、0.1。

All models are trained using 2 RTX 3090 GPUs.

所有模型使用2张 RTX 3090 GPU 训练。

Test Data. We evaluate StableCodec on the test set of CLIC 2020 Professional [60] (CLIC 2020 Test), the validation set of DIV2K [1] (DIV2K Val) and Kodak [16] following [26, 40].

测试数据：遵循文献[26,40]，在 CLIC 2020 Professional 测试集、DIV2K 验证集和 Kodak 上评估。

CLIC 2020 Test and DIV2K Val contain 428 and 100 high-quality 2K-resolution natural images, respectively, while Kodak contains 24 natural images with a smaller resolution of 768×512.

前两者分别包含428张和100张高质量2K自然图像，Kodak 包含24张768×512自然图像。

We evaluate all images with the original resolution as detailed in the supplementary.

所有图像均按原始分辨率评估，细节见补充材料。

Evaluation Metrics. We employ established metrics to assess the rate-distortion-perception performance of Stable- Codec.

评估指标：采用成熟指标衡量率—失真—感知性能。

Concretely, we measure bitrate by bits per pixel (bpp), and evaluate perceptual quality using FID [22], KID [6], DISTS [14] and LPIPS [74] (using AlexNet features by default).

码率用 bpp，感知质量用 FID [22]、KID [6]、DISTS [14] 和默认采用 AlexNet 特征的 LPIPS [74]。

Meanwhile, we use PSNR and MS-SSIM [64] to measure the reconstruction fidelity.

同时用 PSNR 与 MS-SSIM [64] 衡量保真度。

We follow [26, 40, 46] to calculate FID and KID on 256×256 patches, and neglect the results on Kodak as it is too small for calculating.

遵循文献[26,40,46]，在256×256图像块上计算 FID 和 KID；Kodak 规模太小，不报告这两项。

Note that pixel-level distortion metrics like LPIPS, PSNR and MS-SSIM have strong limitations when evaluating image compression at ultra-low bitrates [11, 14, 26, 35].

需要注意，LPIPS、PSNR、MS-SSIM 等像素对应的失真指标，在评估超低码率图像压缩时有较强局限[11,14,26,35]。

Therefore, for StableCodec, we focus primarily on FID, KID, and DISTS, which offer a more accurate assessment of quality in severely compressed images.

因此，StableCodec 主要关注 FID、KID 和 DISTS，以更准确评估严重压缩图像的质量。补充材料提供用户研究作视觉验证。

We also provide user study in the supplementary to visually validate the results. Compared Methods. We compare StableCodec with advanced image compression methods: (1) Traditional Codec H.266/VVC [10] by VTM-23.0 intra coding, (2) Neural Codec ELIC [20], (3) Generative Codec HiFiC [43], Text+Sketch [35], MS-ILLM [46], PerCo [11], EGIC [31], DiffEIC [40], TACO [34] and GLC [26].

对比方法：包括传统 H.266/VVC [10]，采用 VTM-23.0 帧内编码；神经编解码器 ELIC [20]；生成式 HiFiC [43]、Text+Sketch [35]、MS-ILLM [46]、PerCo [11]、EGIC [31]、DiffEIC [40]、TACO [34]、GLC [26]。

Note that some methods do not release models for ultra-low bitrates, we either re-train or finetune existing weights to reach specific bitrates.

部分方法没有公开超低码率模型，因此重新训练或微调已有权重达到指定码率。

For PerCo and GLC that do not have official codes, we use PerCo (SD) [32] as a substitute, and request for the results of GLC under the same evaluation approach1.

PerCo 和 GLC 没有官方代码，我们以 PerCo (SD) [32] 替代，并向 GLC 作者索取相同评估方式下的结果。

We equip PerCo and Text+Sketch with the same inference strategy for a fair comparison on high-resolution images.

为公平比较高分辨率图像，PerCo 与 Text+Sketch 使用相同推理策略。

4.2. Main Results

4.2. 主要结果

4.2.1. Rate-Distortion-Perception Performance

4.2.1. 率—失真—感知性能

Fig. 6 presents the rate-perception and rate-distortion curves of various methods at ultra-low bitrates over CLIC 2020 Test and DIV2K Val.

图6给出不同方法在 CLIC 2020 测试集和 DIV2K 验证集上的超低码率率感知与率失真曲线。

The proposed StableCodec outperforms all compared methods in terms of FID, KID, and DISTS.

StableCodec 在 FID、KID 和 DISTS 上优于所有对比方法。

Specifically, StableCodec shows a significant improvement over H.266/VVC and ELIC on all perceptual metrics.

具体而言，相比 H.266/VVC 和 ELIC，所有感知指标均显著改善。

Compared to generative codec especially previous SOTA GLC [26], StableCodec demonstrates superiority and stability on FID and KID performance with well-preserved fidelity, and reaches extreme bitrates as low as 0.005 bpp.

相比生成式编解码器，尤其是此前领先的 GLC [26]，StableCodec 在较好保留保真度的同时，FID、KID 更优且更稳定，并能达到0.005 bpp的极低码率。

Although TACO [34] achieves the best LPIPS performance, it fails to ensure visual quality as FID, KID and DISTS scores are high.

尽管 TACO [34] 的 LPIPS 最好，但其 FID、KID、DISTS 较高，未能保证视觉质量。

4.2.2. Qualitative Comparisons

4.2.2. 定性比较

We provide qualitative results among compared methods in Fig. 7.

图7展示各方法的定性结果。

Notably, StableCodec generates more visuallyaligned details and realistic textures at ultra-low bitrates, such as the teeth and murals shown in the first and third rows.

StableCodec 在超低码率下生成与原图更一致的细节和更逼真的纹理，例如第一行的牙齿和第三行的壁画。

In contrast, all other methods fail to produce highrealism results with well-preserved fidelity due to the severe bitrate restriction.

相比之下，其他方法受严格码率限制，未能同时生成高真实性并保持良好保真度。

For example, ELIC and MS-ILLM produce blurry reconstructions, while PerCo and DiffEIC deviate from the original images.

例如 ELIC 和 MS-ILLM 重建模糊，PerCo 和 DiffEIC 偏离原图。

EGIC and TACO exhibit noticeable artifacts, particularly in detailed areas.

EGIC 和 TACO 出现明显伪影，尤其是在细节区域。

4.2.3. Computational Complexity

4.2.3. 计算复杂度

We compare the practical complexity of StableCodec with representative schemes in Table 2 using a single RTX 3090 GPU.

表2使用单张 RTX 3090 比较 StableCodec 与代表性方案的实际复杂度。

Among representative image compression schemes, Diffusion-based methods [11, 35, 40] typically suffer from a much longer decoding time compared to VAE-based [20, 27] or GAN-based [43, 46] competitors due to multistep denoising.

由于多步去噪，扩散方法[11,35,40]的解码耗时通常远大于 VAE 方法[20,27]或 GAN 方法[43,46]。

In contrast, StableCodec reaches comparable encoding and decoding speed against these methods exploiting one-step denoising, deep compression transforms and efficient entropy model, while achieving significantly better performance at ultra-low bitrates.

相比之下，StableCodec 借助单步去噪、深度压缩变换与高效熵模型，达到与这些方法相近的编解码速度，同时在超低码率下性能显著更好。

Detailed runtime analysis is provided in the supplementary.

详细运行时间分析见补充材料。

In terms of memory, StableCodec consumes less than 9 GB VRAM with tiling techniques [29, 63], supporting arbitrary-resolution inference on a single GTX 1080Ti GPU.

显存方面，StableCodec 采用分块技术[29,63]，消耗小于9 GB，可在单张 GTX 1080Ti 上支持任意分辨率推理。

5. Ablation Studies

5. 消融研究

In this section, we conduct ablations to validate the proposed components.

本节通过消融验证各组件。

For reliable comparison, we compute the BD-rate [7] with Rate-Y curves on Kodak [16] using four target bitrates, where Y denotes specific metrics among PSNR, MS-SSIM, LPIPS, and DISTS.

为可靠比较，在 Kodak [16] 上使用四个目标码率，依据 Rate–Y 曲线计算 BD-rate [7]，其中 Y 为 PSNR、MS-SSIM、LPIPS 或 DISTS。

Auxiliary Encoder and Decoder. We begin by providing numerical results for the auxiliary coding branch in Table 3.

辅助编码器与解码器：表3给出辅助编码分支的数值结果。

Specifically, we construct a base model without EAux and DAux, and a variant with EAux only.

具体而言，构建不含 E_Aux 和 D_Aux 的基础模型，以及只含 E_Aux 的变体。

When EAux is incorporated, more than 20% bits can be saved to reach the same reconstruction quality.

加入 E_Aux 后，达到相同重建质量可节省超过20%比特。

Subsequently, DAux further improves the performance particularly in perceptual quality.

随后加入 D_Aux 进一步改善性能，尤其是感知质量。

As shown in Fig. 5, the purified gs latent provides better guidance for reconstruction consistency.

如图5所示，更纯净的 g_s 潜变量为重建一致性提供更好引导。

LoRA Ranks. We explore the impact of LoRA ranks in Table 4.

LoRA 秩：表4探索 LoRA 秩的影响。

Positive results are observed in both distortion and perception as the ranks increase to 16/32, which become our final choice.

秩增加至16/32时，失真与感知均改善，因此采用该设置。

For larger ranks like 32 and 64, we observe performance degradation as the pre-trained priors may be corrupted.

更大的秩，如32和64，可能破坏预训练先验，导致性能下降。

Besides, adding LoRA to the VAE decoder introduces a distortion-perception tradeoff, where PSNR and MS-SSIM improve at the cost of LPIPS and DISTS.

此外，为 VAE 解码器加入 LoRA 会引入失真—感知权衡，PSNR 和 MS-SSIM 提升，但 LPIPS 和 DISTS 变差。

To preserve perceptual quality, we leave the decoder unchanged.

为保持感知质量，我们不修改解码器。

Training Strategy. We perform ablations on our training strategy components in Table 5.

训练策略：表5消融训练策略组件。

We construct a simplified one-stage objective with bitrate, MSE and LPIPS, then progressively integrate the two-stage implicit bitrate pruning (IBP), adversarial training Ladv and the CLIP distance term LCLIP .

首先构造仅含码率、MSE、LPIPS的简化单阶段目标，再逐步加入两阶段隐式码率剪枝 IBP、对抗训练 L_adv 和 CLIP 距离 L_CLIP。

We find that IBP improves performance considerably by first adapting the latent codec into the T2I model with relaxed bitrate constraint.

IBP 先在宽松码率约束下将潜变量编解码器适配到文生图模型，因此显著提升性能。

Furthermore, incorporating GAN introduces a significant distortion-perception tradeoff since we primarily focus on the perceptual quality.

进一步加入 GAN 后，由于主要关注感知质量，出现明显失真—感知权衡。

Besides, the CLIP distance alleviates the degradation in distortion and slightly improves perceptual quality.

CLIP 距离则缓解失真退化，并略微提高感知质量。

Table 5. Ablation study on the training strategy components.

表5. 训练策略各组件的消融。

Implicit bitrate pruning is abbreviated as IBP.

隐式码率剪枝简称 IBP。

The base one-stage objective only contains bitrate, MSE and LPIPS.

基础单阶段目标仅包含码率、MSE 和 LPIPS。

6. Conclusion

6. 结论

In this work, we introduce StableCodec, a novel diffusionbased extreme image compression approach that addresses key limitations of existing methods.

本文提出新的扩散式极低码率图像压缩方法 StableCodec，解决现有方法的关键局限。

By leveraging one-step diffusion in combination with Deep Compression Latent Codec and Dual-Branch Coding Structure, StableCodec achieves ultra-low bitrate compression with high realism, fidelity, and coding efficiency.

结合单步扩散、深度压缩潜变量编解码器和双分支编码结构，实现兼具高真实性、保真度和编码效率的超低码率压缩。

Extensive experimental evaluations on benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of StableCodec in terms of FID, KID, and DISTS, even at extreme bitrates as low as 0.005 bpp, while enabling competitive speeds with mainstream transform coding methods.

在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，即使码率低至0.005 bpp，StableCodec 在 FID、KID、DISTS 上仍具有优势，同时速度可与主流变换编码方法竞争。

These results underscore the potential of diffusion models for practical image compression, particularly in real-time coding scenarios where bitrate is severely constrained.

这些结果凸显了扩散模型在实际图像压缩，尤其是码率严格受限的实时编码场景中的潜力。
